text:
If you're under 25 and still not taking lifestyle photos, read this twice.

How women read your profile:

1. Travel photos. Signals you have money or spend it on experiences.

2. Restaurant photos. Signals you go out and enjoy yourself.

3. Good backgrounds. Rooftop. Pool. Ocean. Signals your life has good moments.

You don't need to be rich. One good trip. One nice dinner. Photographed well. That's enough.

Your photos prove you exist. His photos prove he lives.
caption:
Dating psychology at 25. Women check your photos to see if you have resources. That's the first signal.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
